GRT Jewellers to acquire majority stake in Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri

GRT Jewellers has announced plans to acquire a 74.12% stake in Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri (TBZ). The deal involves GRT Jewellers buying out the promoters of TBZ for ₹1,034 crore. This acquisition will give GRT Jewellers a majority ownership in the publicly listed jewellery company.
